question: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011 and Reputation > 1000), COUNT(Id) ) * 100;
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching posts record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND T1.Reputation > 1000, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND T1.Reputation > 1000, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND u.Reputation > 1000 THEN p.Id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.Id), 0) AS percentage FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id;

d.request: What percentage of posts created in 2011 had owners with a reputation over 1,000, while retaining owners with no matching post records?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Id IS NOT NULL AND u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.Id), 0) AS percentage FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id AND p.CreaionDate >= '2011-01-01' AND p.CreaionDate < '2012-01-01';

b.request: What percentage of posts belong to users who joined in 2011 and have a reputation above 1,000, including users with no matching post in the joined results?
b.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(p.Id) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts), 0), 2) AS percentage_of_posts FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.CreationDate >= '2011-01-01' AND u.CreationDate < '2012-01-01' AND u.Reputation > 1000;
